# The purpose of this script is to evaluate the intersignal intervals for striped bass acoustic detections in Eel Pond, MA

```{r Data cleaning}
# Libraries
library(readxl)
library(dplyr)
library(purrr)
library(stringr)
library(lubridate)

# 1. Load & Tidy Data -----------------------------------------
file <- "/Users/carolineianniello/Seasonal_timing_striped_bass/ISI_SBI_Raw_Data.xlsx"
sheets <- excel_sheets(file)

# Use map_dfr to get a single tibble at the end
clean_data <- map_dfr(sheets, function(sh) {
  df <- read_excel(file, sheet = sh, col_types = "text")
  
  # REMOVE completely empty columns
  df <- df[, colSums(!is.na(df)) > 0]
  
  n <- ncol(df)
  groups <- split(seq_len(n), ceiling(seq_len(n) / 3))
  
  bind_rows(lapply(groups, function(cols) {
    if (length(cols) < 3) return(NULL)
    
    sub <- df[, cols]
    colnames(sub) <- c("Tag_ID", "datetime", "Bits")
    
    sub %>%
      filter(
        !is.na(Tag_ID),
        !str_detect(Tag_ID, "Tag_ID|Date"),
        !is.na(datetime),
        datetime != ""
      ) %>%
      mutate(
        datetime = str_squish(datetime),
        datetime = ifelse(
          str_detect(datetime, "^\\d+(\\.\\d+)?$"),
          as.character(as.POSIXct(as.numeric(datetime)*86400,
                                 origin="1899-12-30", tz="UTC")),
          datetime
        ),
        Bits = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(Bits)),
        datetime = suppressWarnings(
          parse_date_time(
            datetime,
            orders = c("mdy HM", "mdy HMS", "ymd HM", "ymd HMS"),
            tz = "UTC"
          )
        )
      )
  })) %>%
  mutate(year = sh)
})

# 2. QA diagnostic: Did all rows parse?
cat("\nALL CLEAN DATA BEFORE FILTERING:\n")
print(clean_data)
cat("\nYEAR TABLE:\n")
print(table(clean_data$year))
cat("\nDATETIME NAs by year:\n")
print(table(clean_data$year, is.na(clean_data$datetime)))

# 2. Remove data before 2019 (before analyses) ------------------------------
min_ok_date <- as.POSIXct("2019-01-01", tz = "UTC")
clean_data_before_filter <- clean_data

clean_data <- clean_data %>%
  filter(!is.na(datetime)) %>%
  filter(datetime > min_ok_date) %>%
  arrange(year, Tag_ID, datetime)

# Investigate what rows were dropped
dropped_rows <- anti_join(clean_data_before_filter, clean_data, by = c("Tag_ID", "datetime", "Bits", "year"))
cat("\nRows dropped by filter:\n")
print(dropped_rows)

# 3. Calculate Intervals ---------------------------------------
intervals <- clean_data %>%
  group_by(year, Tag_ID) %>%
  mutate(diff_min = as.numeric(difftime(datetime, lag(datetime), units = "mins"))) %>%
  filter(!is.na(diff_min), diff_min > 0)

summary_stats <- intervals %>%
  group_by(year, Tag_ID) %>%   # Now by year!
  summarise(
    mean_interval = mean(diff_min),
    median_interval = median(diff_min),
    min_interval = min(diff_min),
    max_interval = max(diff_min),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

overall <- summary_stats %>%
  summarise(
    min_mean = min(mean_interval),
    max_mean = max(mean_interval),
    median_mean = median(mean_interval)
  )

# 4. Summary Output -------------------------------------
cat("\nDate range for detections:\n")
print(range(clean_data$datetime))
cat("\nDistribution of all positive ISI (min):\n")
print(summary(intervals$diff_min))
cat("\nSummary table (per-fish mean ISI range & median):\n")
print(overall)
cat("\nPer-fish, per-year summary:\n")
print(summary_stats)

# 5. Histrogram -----------------
hist(summary_stats$mean_interval,
     main = "Average Inter-Signal Interval per Fish",
     xlab = "Mean ISI (min)")
```

```{r histogram for all fish}
#Histogram for individuals with ISI under 60 minutes
hist(intervals$diff_min[intervals$diff_min < 60],  
     breaks = 100,
     main = "Intervals (<60 min)",
     xlab = "Interval (minutes)",
     col = "skyblue")

intervals <- intervals %>%
  left_join(clean_data %>% select(Tag_ID, datetime, year), by = c("Tag_ID", "datetime"))
library(ggplot2)
ggplot(intervals %>% filter(diff_min < 60), aes(x = diff_min)) +
  geom_histogram(binwidth = 1, fill = "skyblue", color = "black") +
  facet_wrap(~year) +
  labs(title = "Inter-signal Interval Distribution (<60 min) by Year",
       x = "Interval (minutes)", y = "Count") +
  theme_bw()


```

```{r summary stats}
# Remove extreme values (e.g., seasonal gaps) if desired:

intervals_use <- intervals 

n <- sum(!is.na(intervals_use$diff_min))
mu <- mean(intervals_use$diff_min, na.rm = TRUE)
sd_isi <- sd(intervals_use$diff_min, na.rm = TRUE)
sem <- sd_isi / sqrt(n)
med <- median(intervals_use$diff_min, na.rm = TRUE)
min_isi <- min(intervals_use$diff_min, na.rm = TRUE)
max_isi <- max(intervals_use$diff_min, na.rm = TRUE)
q1 <- quantile(intervals_use$diff_min, 0.25, na.rm = TRUE)
q3 <- quantile(intervals_use$diff_min, 0.75, na.rm = TRUE)

cat(
  sprintf(
    "n = %d\nMean = %.2f min\nSD = %.2f min\nSEM = %.2f min\nMedian = %.2f min\nQ1 = %.2f min\nQ3 = %.2f min\nMin = %.2f min\nMax = %.2f min\n",
    n, mu, sd_isi, sem, med, q1, q3, min_isi, max_isi
  )
)

#percentage of intervals under 20 minutes
# Count number and percent of intervals under 20 minutes (excluding NAs)
n_total <- sum(!is.na(intervals$diff_min))
n_under_20 <- sum(intervals$diff_min < 20, na.rm = TRUE)
pct_under_20 <- 100 * n_under_20 / n_total

cat(sprintf(
  "%d of %d intervals (%.1f%%) are under 20 minutes\n",
  n_under_20, n_total, pct_under_20
))
```

```{r}
# Per fish mean ISI
summary_stats <- intervals %>%
  group_by(Tag_ID) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_isi = mean(diff_min, na.rm = TRUE)
  )
min_mean <- min(summary_stats$mean_isi, na.rm = TRUE)
max_mean <- max(summary_stats$mean_isi, na.rm = TRUE)
median_mean <- median(summary_stats$mean_isi, na.rm = TRUE)

cat(sprintf(
  "Per-fish mean ISI: Range %.1f to %.1f min (median: %.1f min)\n",
  min_mean, max_mean, median_mean
))
```
